payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Offline probe on current main: 'phone contact after discharge' (confidence 0.432, above the 0.42 cutoff), 'car accident trauma assessment', 'tv watching and negative symptoms', 'holiday leave from the ward' and 'flight of ideas in mania' still short-circuit. 'restaurant avoidance in social anxiety' now reaches retrieval via the psychiatricOrClinicalContextPattern override (3f2bb4771); 'mania' and 'discharge' are not in that override. Partial mitigation only. PRIOR DETAIL: Found while fixing #000GN4 (2026-09-02, probed against the real analyzeClinicalQuery on main at 45a3dcacb54a). src/lib/rag/rag-query-guard.ts:3-4 short-circuits any soft-tail-eligible query matching bare tokens including phone, car, tv, television, restaurant, holiday, hotel, flight, kitchen and laptop. Measured, with shouldShortCircuitUnsupportedSearch on the real analyzer: 'phone contact after discharge' short-circuits to zero retrieval while 'telephone follow up after discharge' reaches retrieval, and the word 'phone' is the only difference. Post-discharge phone contact is a topic this repo actively builds for - see the Caring Contacts work. Also confirmed refused by the pattern alone, with confidence and expandedTerms both above the soft-tail thresholds so the pattern is the sole cause: 'restaurant avoidance in social anxiety', 'car accident trauma assessment', 'tv watching and negative symptoms', 'holiday leave from the ward'. Separately, the token 'flight' matches 'flight of ideas', a core sign of mania, though that query would short-circuit through the soft tail anyway. This is milder than #000GN4 because these tokens sit behind unsupportedSoftTailEligible rather than firing unconditionally, but the mechanism is identical: a bare token standing in for a topic judgement. FIX: the same shape as #000GN4 - replace bare tokens with phrases that cannot occur in a clinical question, or route the decision through classifyCorpusGrounding where the query is soft-tail eligible anyway. Protected RAG surface: needs the RAG impact declaration, the clinical governance preflight, and an eval:quality --rag-only run, since the consumer controls in rag-eval-cases.ts (coffee machine, air fryer, overnight oats) are what this pattern pins. Note unavailableDocumentNoisePattern was checked in the same pass and is clean - every entry there is a multi-word phrase.
